title: Jump Game
description: Given an array where each element is the maximum jump length from that position, starting at index 0, return whether you can reach the last index.

reference.use_case: Deciding whether you can get from the start to the end of a route when each stop lets you advance up to a certain distance, such as whether a vehicle can reach its destination given the range it gains at each charging stop.
system_examples: EV and drone route planning — checking whether a destination is reachable given range limits at each charging point
Relay networks — whether a message can traverse a chain of relays with limited transmission ranges
reference.explanation: Track the farthest index reachable so far in a single pass: if you ever stand beyond that frontier you are stuck, giving O(n) time and O(1) space. It is a minimal example of replacing DP over positions with a running 'best frontier' invariant.
